name: AD Credential Access Chain
description: Purple-Team-Automation adversary profile. Chains four custom credential-access abilities against the AD domain lab, in the order an opportunistic internal attacker would typically attempt them: broad account discovery via password spraying, then progressively more privileged credential theft techniques, culminating in a full DCSync of the domain. LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning (T1557.001) is deliberately excluded from this profile, Stockpile's only ability for it (Inveigh) is Windows-only and cannot run on this lab's Linux/Sandcat agent, and is instead documented separately as a known-gap negative control (see validation/llmnr-known-gap.md).
